title: Canonical tensor-dual evaluation for a finite free retract
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a site, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and suppose additive-group sheafification exists and $J$-local equivalences of additive-group presheaves are exactly locally bijective maps. Use the category of $R$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], its tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], internal Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom] and canonical tensor-Hom adjunction [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Let $E,B$ be module sheaves and assume there exist $m\geq0$ and maps $i:E\to R^{\oplus m}$, $p:R^{\oplus m}\to E$ with $p\circ i=1_E$. Put $E^\vee=\mathcal Hom(E,R)$. Then the canonical evaluation comparison $B\otimes E^\vee\to\mathcal Hom(E,B)$ sending $b\otimes\phi$ to $(e\mapsto b\phi(e))$ is an isomorphism. The map is the adjunct of the composite $E\otimes(B\otimes E^\vee)\to B\otimes(E^\vee\otimes E)\to B\otimes R\to B$ using symmetry, associativity, evaluation and the right unit action. No flatness or quasi-coherence is assumed of $B$.

proof.text: Prove precomposition naturality directly from tensorHomEquiv_whiskerLeft_comp and tensorHomEquiv_whiskerRight_comp, braiding naturality and associator naturality. The underlying evaluation obeys E tensor Hom(f,R) followed by evaluation = f tensor Hom(F,R) followed by evaluation. These identities give naturality of moduleDualEvaluation in E.

Identify moduleDualEvaluation with braiding followed by the source MonoidalClosed.ihomUnitTensorToIhom. Uncurry both sides; the two hexagon identities, symmetry, and braiding naturality with evaluation identify the composites. For E the unit, source MonoidalClosed.isIso_ihomUnitTensorToIhom applies to the canonical exact pairing of the unit with itself, proving unit evaluation invertible.

For I = ULift (Fin m), identify free I with the biproduct of I copies of the unit using biproduct.isoCoproduct. Write i_j: R to free I and p_j: free I to R for its inclusions and projections, so sum_j p_j followed by i_j = identity on free I. The inverse to evaluation is sum_j Hom(i_j,B) followed by inverse unit evaluation followed by B tensor Hom(p_j,R). Naturality reduces either inverse equation to the sum of Hom(p_j followed by i_j,-). Additivity of the source internal Hom functor (InternalHomFree) and of tensorLeft (MonoidalFree) turns this sum into Hom(identity,-), and hence the identity. Use the universe-polymorphic IsBilimit.total for the biproduct equation. Empty I gives the zero-object case without an extra hypothesis.

Given i:E to free I and p:free I to E with i followed by p = identity, set the inverse to Hom(p,B) followed by inverse free evaluation followed by B tensor Hom(i,R). Apply the proved naturality twice. The free inverse equations cancel the middle maps, and Hom functoriality together with i followed by p = identity makes both composites identities. This constructs the inverse without choosing any data from an unproved existence theorem.
